minutes.summary: The Select Board (chair, Glenn, and Brian) held a short meeting largely devoted to annual appointments. They passed over discontinuing electronic voting machines for the August 2026 special election after learning from the state it isn't optional, then voted by roll call to make the Select Board's own annual appointments and to ratify the Town Manager's lengthy list of annual town appointments, including the full police department roster, before adjourning.
minutes.headline: Electronic voting machines can't be discontinued for the August special election — the state says they're mandatory.
